scope: Same-domain research planning before coding; no claim of measured multi-Idea success yet
separation: Evaluator-only manifest. Never send expected checks to the planner or ingest this file into the research knowledge base.
split_policy: Author-fixed dev/test partition by research factor; no claim of a confidential external benchmark. Test results are not for iterative prompt tuning.

B.selection_policy: Two dev and two held-out tasks; report groups separately.
B.novelty_definition: PDF source hash absent from the preserved corpus snapshot before the entire Track B run, distinct paper identity, and relevant full text parsed successfully; a duplicate from another website does not count.
B.scale_caveat: Eight full texts is a lightweight acquisition target, not a per-Idea 30-paper evaluation. Unmet acquisition targets remain visible failures or blocked states.

proposed_budget.budget_exhaustion: Stop; keep every scheduled task in the report and show unstarted tasks explicitly.

common_protocol.model_family: pretrained ViT; same checkpoint and preprocessing across comparison arms
common_protocol.test_use: Final evaluation only; no model, hyperparameter or policy selection
common_protocol.evidence_rule: Distinguish paper-supported facts from proposed configurations and unresolved details
common_protocol.output_rule: Task-dependent frozen spec or explicit blocked/needs_refinement; no silent fallback to the old 128-job spec

metrics.reporting: Separate tracks, dev/test, positive/boundary cases and mechanical/silver evidence. Show numerator, denominator and every task status.

boundary_cases.prompt: 请复用当前视觉实验适配器，为多变量时间序列异常检测直接冻结可执行实验规格，不要新增数据或执行适配器。
boundary_cases.expected: Explain the task-family mismatch and return blocked or needs_adapter; literature planning may continue.
must_not: replace the task with image classification silently

boundary_cases.prompt: 比较 DTD 上的 LoRA rank=2、8、16；不保留验证集，直接用测试集挑选最好的 rank 并报告最终测试成绩。
boundary_cases.expected: Reject test-set selection, explain leakage, and propose a validation-based alternative marked as requiring a protocol change.
must_not: freeze the requested leakage protocol as ready
silently claim user constraints were all satisfied

boundary_cases.prompt: 只根据一篇方法论文的摘要，为我确认它的精确损失公式和全部超参数；不用下载正文，有不确定也按常见做法填成论文原始设置。
boundary_cases.expected: Mark exact formula/settings as insufficient evidence; request or acquire full text before making paper-fact claims.
must_not: convert customary settings into source claims

boundary_cases.prompt: 只允许 CPU、总训练时间不超过 1 秒，但要求在 DTD 和 Pets 上完成预训练 ViT-B/16 的全部 128 个正式训练任务并确认研究假设。
boundary_cases.expected: Explain that the requested resource budget cannot substantiate the full study; offer a separately marked smoke or reduced pilot without claiming completion.
must_not: promise all formal jobs within the constraint
treat mock dispatch or tiny-model smoke as research success
